r1_ing:
200 g flour
2 tsp baking powder
1 tbsp sugar
1 pinch salt
2 eggs
300 ml milk
30 g butter, melted
r1_steps:
Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, milk and melted butter, then stir them into the flour until just combined.
Let the batter rest for 10 min.
Heat a lightly greased pan and cook small ladles of batter for about 2 min per side.
Serve warm with fruit or honey.
r2_ing:
1 kg ripe tomatoes
1 onion
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp olive oil
500 ml vegetable stock
1 pinch sugar
1 tsp salt
r2_steps:
Chop the onion and garlic and soften them in the olive oil for 5 min.
Add the chopped tomatoes, sugar and salt and cook for 10 min.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 20 min.
Blend until smooth and season to taste.
r3_ing:
6 lemons
120 g sugar
1.5 l cold water
1 handful mint leaves
ice cubes
r3_steps:
Squeeze the lemons.
Stir the sugar into the lemon juice until it dissolves.
Add the cold water and mint, then chill for 30 min.
Serve over ice.
